400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client, FilePurpose
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateFileRequest
from liter_llm import BadRequestError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = CreateFileRequest.from_json("{\"file\":\"data.jsonl\",\"purpose\":\"invalid-purpose\"}")
        await client.create_file(req)
    except BadRequestError as error:
        print(f"BadRequestError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
